title: command_timeout_secs configured but never applied — DoS via connection hold
description: Trigger: attacker opens max_connections connections (default 100) and stalls each one without sending anything or sending very slowly. Behavior: semaphore fills, no new connections accepted. Legitimate senders are blocked indefinitely. config.limits.command_timeout_secs is deserialized, has a default (300s), and is documented in the config struct, but no tokio::time::timeout wraps any read_line() call in session.rs. Fix: wrap every reader.read_line() call in timeout(Duration::from_secs(config.limits.command_timeout_secs), ...) and close the session on Elapsed.
